verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth's own repo documents sign-in with external providers such as Google, Apple, Facebook, and Discord. Its docs point to Custom OAuth/OIDC Providers for any unlisted provider, and providers are managed from the project's auth providers dashboard and auth config settings, so the core of the story is delivered by the product itself. Community evidence corroborates Google sign-in working but notes the React Native OAuth flow took extra effort. Missing for 10: an explicit, enumerated provider list and step-by-step configuration-only setup documentation in the evidence, plus smoother independent hands-on corroboration across client platforms.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer sign-in with a broad set of social and OAuth identity providers through configuration, not custom code

citations.quote: Sign in with external providers (Google, Apple, Facebook, Discord, ...)
